Bzlmod setup of Godot engines (prebuilt releases, sources and source builds) and of
experimental Android toolchains for each execution platform.

<a id="godot_android_toolchains"></a>

## godot_android_toolchains

<pre>
godot_android_toolchains = use_extension("@autoload_rules_godot//godot:extensions.bzl", "godot_android_toolchains")
godot_android_toolchains.configure(<a href="#godot_android_toolchains.configure-ndk_api_level">ndk_api_level</a>)
</pre>

Register Android SDK and NDK toolchains for each execution platform. Experimental: the
extension, its tag and its generated repository may change without notice.

rules_android and rules_android_ndk resolve their tools from this host's SDK and NDK for
every execution platform, so a remote Linux executor, such as BuildBuddy's, would run
this host's `aapt2` and clang. This extension registers this host's NDK
(`ANDROID_NDK_HOME`) for this host's operating system only, and SDK, Android and NDK
toolchains for linux/x86_64 execution platforms: on hosts other than Linux, of the
checksum-pinned Linux build tools 35.0.0, SDK platforms 35 and 36 and NDK r29, which
Bazel downloads only when toolchain resolution selects them; on a Linux host, of this
host's SDK and NDK. Actions on this host keep rules_android's toolchains of the host SDK
(`ANDROID_HOME`). The Linux SDK follows `--@androidsdk//:api_level`; on hosts other than
Linux, another API level fails analysis for Linux executors.

The generated hub `android_toolchains` replaces `@androidndk//:all` of rules_android_ndk.
Register it with `--extra_toolchains`, which gives it priority over the toolchains
rules_android registers in its own module.

Example (MODULE.bazel):
```starlark
godot_android_toolchains = use_extension(
    "@autoload_rules_godot//godot:extensions.bzl",
    "godot_android_toolchains",
)
godot_android_toolchains.configure(ndk_api_level = 24)
use_repo(godot_android_toolchains, "android_toolchains")
```

Example (.bazelrc):
```
build:android --extra_toolchains=@android_toolchains//:all
```

The root module's tag applies; without one, the dependencies' tags must agree. See
[remote execution of Android builds](../../platforms.md#remote-execution-of-android-builds).

### Default outputs
- repository (none): repository creation; generated entrypoints described below

### Generated targets
- `@android_toolchains//:ndk_{target_system}` (metadata): the C++ toolchain of this host's NDK for one Android CPU, on this host's operating system; register the package with :all
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
  - prerequisites: ANDROID_NDK_HOME
- `@android_toolchains//:ndk_linux_x86_64_{target_system}` (metadata): the C++ toolchain of the Linux NDK for one Android CPU, on linux/x86_64 execution platforms; this host's NDK on a Linux host
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
- `@android_toolchains//:sdk_linux_x86_64` (metadata): the Linux SDK of the selected API level, on linux/x86_64 execution platforms; this host's SDK on a Linux host
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
- `@android_toolchains//:android_linux_x86_64` (metadata): rules_android's Android toolchain with the Linux aapt2, on linux/x86_64 execution platforms; rules_android's default on a Linux host
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
- `@android_toolchains//:aapt` (executable): aapt of the configured platform's SDK, the Linux SDK's for linux/x86_64 and this host's otherwise, for the data of a test that inspects an application on its execution platform
  - prerequisites: ANDROID_HOME
- `@android_toolchains//:aapt2` (executable): aapt2 of the configured platform's SDK, as :aapt
  - prerequisites: ANDROID_HOME

Declare Godot engines and generate their registration hubs.

The prebuilt tag acquires one version's editors and export templates, from the
built-in catalogue or from explicit pins, and generates a hub whose `toolchains`
package declares one public component per slot. The source tag acquires an immutable
source archive; the source_build tag builds source recipes from it for the slots it selects and generates a hub
of the same layout. Register hubs from the root module; registration order decides
between candidates for the same slot. Hubs use only public primitives: the archive,
source and recipe repository rules and the component macros. Downloads and
configuration happen only for payloads a build requests.

Example (MODULE.bazel):
```starlark
godot_engines = use_extension("@autoload_rules_godot//godot:extensions.bzl", "godot_engines")
godot_engines.prebuilt(name = "godot_prebuilt", version = "4.7.2")
godot_engines.source(
    name = "godot_sources",
    sha256 = "e954996374cbd1cb5d72e0e3781cc537408e6ce73b010b12c6c2f308a820690a",
    strip_prefix = "godot-4.7.2-stable",
    urls = ["https://github.com/godotengine/godot/archive/refs/tags/4.7.2-stable.tar.gz"],
    version = "4.7.2",
)
godot_engines.source_build(
    name = "godot_source_build",
    platforms = ["ios"],
    source = "@godot_sources//:source.json",
)
use_repo(godot_engines, "godot_source_build", "godot_prebuilt", "godot_sources")
register_toolchains(
    "@godot_source_build//toolchains:all",  # wins for the iOS slots it covers
    "@godot_prebuilt//toolchains:all",
)
```

A root request owns its name; identical dependency requests share repositories and
conflicting ones fail. See [engines](../../engine.md).

### Default outputs
- repository (none): repository creation; generated entrypoints described above

### Generated targets
- `@{repository}//toolchains:editor_{platform}_{cpu}` (files): the editor component of one editor slot; register the package with :all
  - prerequisites: editor archive for the editor platform
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_linux_{cpu}_{variant}` (files): the Linux runtime component of one runtime slot
  - prerequisites: template archive contains the slot
  - availability: desktop
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_macos_{cpu}_{variant}` (files): the macOS runtime component of one runtime slot
  - prerequisites: template archive contains the slot
  - availability: desktop
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_ios_{cpu}_{environment}_{variant}` (files): the iOS runtime component of one device or simulator slot
  - prerequisites: template archive contains the slot, or build_missing_runtimes with catalogued sources
  - availability: ios
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_android_{cpu}_{variant}` (files): the Android runtime component of one slot
  - prerequisites: Android shell AAR pinned, or build_missing_runtimes with catalogued sources
  - availability: android_shell
- `@{repository}//android:{variant}` (files): the Android runtime of one template variant the components use
  - prerequisites: Android shell library pinned, a source build with Android rows, or build_missing_runtimes with catalogued sources
  - availability: android_shell
- `@{repository}//android:plugin_api` (files): the shell library's classes for Android plugins to compile against, never packaged; applications package the runtime of their variant
  - prerequisites: Android shell library pinned or a source build with Android rows
  - availability: android_shell
- `@{repository}//:source.json` (files): the descriptor of a source tag, for source_build tags and godot_engine_build recipes
  - prerequisites: source tag
  - availability: source
- `@{repository}//:{archive}` (files): the archive of a source tag
  - prerequisites: source tag
  - availability: source
- `@{repository}//toolchains:editor_{platform}_{cpu}.toolchain` (metadata): register one editor slot alone, ahead of or instead of the whole set
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_linux_{cpu}_{variant}.toolchain` (metadata): register one runtime slot alone, ahead of or instead of the whole set
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
  - availability: desktop
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_macos_{cpu}_{variant}.toolchain` (metadata): register one runtime slot alone, ahead of or instead of the whole set
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
  - availability: desktop
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_ios_{cpu}_{environment}_{variant}.toolchain` (metadata): register one runtime slot alone, ahead of or instead of the whole set
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
  - availability: ios
- `@{repository}//toolchains:runtime_android_{cpu}_{variant}.toolchain` (metadata): register one runtime slot alone, ahead of or instead of the whole set
  - purpose: analysis_boundary
  - availability: android_shell

### prebuilt

Acquire one version's prebuilt editors and export templates and generate a hub.
Catalogued versions need only version; explicit pins replace catalogue entries.

**Attributes**

| Name  | Description | Type | Mandatory | Default |
| :------------- | :------------- | :------------- | :------------- | :------------- |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-name"></a>name |  Hub repository name; editor and template repositories use it as prefix.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/concepts/labels#target-names">Name</a> | required |  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-android_debug_shell_integrity"></a>android_debug_shell_integrity |  Subresource Integrity digest of the AAR in android_debug_shell_urls.   | String | optional |  `""`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-android_debug_shell_urls"></a>android_debug_shell_urls |  Android shell AAR URLs of a template_debug build with every ABI's engine library; official releases publish none.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-android_shell_integrity"></a>android_shell_integrity |  Subresource Integrity digest of the AAR in android_shell_urls.   | String | optional |  `""`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-android_shell_urls"></a>android_shell_urls |  Android shell AAR URLs, a template_release build with every ABI's engine library; replaces the catalogue's shell.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-build_missing_runtimes"></a>build_missing_runtimes |  Build the runtime slots the prebuilt artifacts lack from the release's sources, such as the arm64 iOS simulator runtimes of 4.7.2 or the Android debug runtimes. Each recipe is configured and compiled only when a build selects its slot. Catalogued versions with pinned sources only; none when templates_urls or editor_urls pin a fork's artifacts, and no Android runtimes when android_shell_urls does.   | Boolean | optional |  `True`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-editor_binaries"></a>editor_binaries |  Editor executable path inside each archive; defaults to the official layout of a catalogued version.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/rules/lib/core/dict">Dictionary: String -> String</a> | optional |  `{}`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-editor_integrity"></a>editor_integrity |  Subresource Integrity digest per editor platform in editor_urls.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/rules/lib/core/dict">Dictionary: String -> String</a> | optional |  `{}`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-editor_urls"></a>editor_urls |  Editor archive URLs by editor platform, such as linux_x86_64, linux_arm64, macos (universal), macos_arm64 or macos_x86_64; replaces the catalogue's editors.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/rules/lib/core/dict">Dictionary: String -> List of strings</a> | optional |  `{}`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-engine"></a>engine |  Name of the engine the hub's components belong to, such as `petri`; builds select it with `--@autoload_rules_godot//godot:engine=petri`, and only then do these components fill slots. Empty, the default, joins the default engine.   | String | optional |  `""`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-ios_simulator_cpus"></a>ios_simulator_cpus |  CPUs with usable code in the templates' iOS simulator XCFramework slice; replaces the catalogue's value. Empty for an uncatalogued version means no simulator runtimes.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-templates_integrity"></a>templates_integrity |  Subresource Integrity digest of the templates in templates_urls.   | String | optional |  `""`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-templates_linux_cpus"></a>templates_linux_cpus |  Linux template CPUs of the templates in templates_urls, as Godot's CPU tags; empty means those of Godot's official templates: arm32, arm64, x86_32 and x86_64.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-templates_macos_cpus"></a>templates_macos_cpus |  macOS layout of the templates in templates_urls: ["universal"] (default) or a subset of ["arm64", "x86_64"].   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-templates_urls"></a>templates_urls |  Export-template archive URLs; replaces the catalogue's templates.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.prebuilt-version"></a>version |  Exact canonical Godot version, such as 4.7.2 or 4.8.0-beta1.   | String | required |  |

<a id="godot_engines.source_build"></a>

### source_build

Build one source build and generate its hub, as godot_engine_source_build does:
one source recipe and one component per valid slot the filters select.

| Name  | Description | Type | Mandatory | Default |
| :------------- | :------------- | :------------- | :------------- | :------------- |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-name"></a>name |  Hub repository name and prefix of the recipe repositories.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/concepts/labels#target-names">Name</a> | required |  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-build_name"></a>build_name |  Build name the engines report in their version.   | String | optional |  `"custom"`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-build_options"></a>build_options |  Upstream configure options, as for godot_engine_build.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/rules/lib/core/dict">Dictionary: String -> String</a> | optional |  `{}`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-build_targets"></a>build_targets |  Optional editor/template_debug/template_release filter; empty selects all.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-configure_timeout"></a>configure_timeout |  Maximum configure duration per recipe, in seconds.   | Integer | optional |  `600`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-cpus"></a>cpus |  Optional arm64/x86_64 filter; empty selects all.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-custom_modules"></a>custom_modules |  Each custom module's config.py label mapped to its module name.   | <a href="https://bazel.build/rules/lib/core/dict">Dictionary: Label -> String</a> | optional |  `{}`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-default_modules"></a>default_modules |  Also enable every module Godot enables by default for the platform, as its official builds do.   | Boolean | optional |  `False`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-enabled_modules"></a>enabled_modules |  Enabled Godot modules; dependencies come from the source's module graph.   | List of strings | optional |  `["gdscript", "text_server_fb"]`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-engine"></a>engine |  Name of the engine the hub's components belong to, such as `petri`; builds select it with `--@autoload_rules_godot//godot:engine=petri`, and only then do these components fill slots. Empty, the default, joins the default engine.   | String | optional |  `""`  |
| <a id="godot_engines.source_build-ios_environments"></a>ios_environments |  Optional device/simulator filter for iOS rows; empty selects both.   | List of strings | optional |  `[]`  |
